title: Oracle: a NUMBER with no precision or scale lands as a string

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: Oracle Free 23.26.3, standard gateway, one run

symptom: NUMBER with no precision or scale lands as a string with the exact digits ('1234.5678', '0.000001', '3.14159'), not as a decimal.
cause: Not established. The code reading expected a decimal.
effect: Numeric comparisons on the column need a cast.
fix: Cast in queries, or declare a precision and scale on the source (not tested).
notes: One run, on snapshot rows and the CDC rows that arrived.
